dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if you can't find ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: Haha, it's at moments like these that you'll need the Teyvat Wilderness Survivalist's Recipes!

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: This contains many summaries on how to whip up survival meals, even though it may be hard for some to accept...

dialogues.speaker: Lynn
dialogues.text: All in all, you should take a look at it if you have the time. Who knows, you might need it someday.
